name: novel-developmental-revision
description: Evaluate and repair manuscript-scale structure, causality, character, pacing, and payoff.
procedure: Diagnose causal, structural, character, pacing, and payoff defects with navigable evidence.
Rank changes by upstream leverage and downstream invalidation cost.
Apply only the assigned bounded revision, re-run diagnostics once, then accept or escalate.
Choose the next step from the author's goal and current project state; keep progress in project docs and verify persisted tool results.
